t.why: It controls the Suez Canal and is a key mediator in Gaza ceasefire talks.
t.rel: The most populous Arab country, with the Suez Canal. It signed a peace treaty with Israel in 1979 and mediates in Gaza talks. It is at odds with Ethiopia over its Nile dam.
t.korea: Korean companies run appliance and car plants there and take part in many infrastructure projects.
t.know: Evidence from their tombs shows the pyramid builders were paid workers, not slaves.
t.etext: Suez Canal tolls, tourism, remittances from workers abroad and natural gas bring in foreign currency. With its large population, it imports huge amounts of wheat. Government debt and inflation have led it to IMF support.
